# Enrich contacts

What a tool does: every vendor’s version of the same job.

Also called: enrichment, contact data.

## Tools (2)

- tool:apollo/enrich-person — Enrich a person (Apollo): Returns one person's title, employer and work email.
- tool:clay/run-routine — Run a routine (Clay): Runs an enrichment function on up to 100 records.

## Workflows (1)

- workflow:champion-job-change-loop — Reconnect when a product champion changes jobs: Track past champions and reopen the relationship.

## Companies (1)

- company:apollo — Apollo: B2B data and outreach.
